correctness.rationale: The source establishes Y normal Gorenstein, its smooth resolution away from vertex and the free torsion-translation action on the resolution. Thus on Y\{0} stabilizers vanish; at vertex t≠0 the nontrivial scalar action on t eliminates stabilizers. The diagonal quotient is consequently étale away from (vertex,0). Its vertex line has invariant coordinate ring k[t]^G=k[t^m]≅k[u], so image is a single affine line. Étale local singularity and Cartier-index properties show this line is singular and Gorenstein off its origin while complement is smooth; source proves index m at origin. The source virtually free quotient mld theorem plus product with smooth A1 gives mld 0+1=1 at every line point, while smooth dimension-three points have mld3. Non-klt exactly along the line by cone discrepancy -1, étale descent and source origin non-klt. No finite numerical experiment substitutes for the all-m argument.
residual_risks: All ingredients are closely suggested by the initiating example; an implicit or later equivalent stratification may already be known.
Only closed-point mld is specified; no claim of mld at arbitrary nonclosed centers or universal index semicontinuity.
